title: Choose the visual world for يَطْمَئِن
question: The roll assigned Reading Room Catalog. Keep it, take an alternate, re-roll, or take the category standard.

options.label: Reading Room Catalog
options.lineage: Arabic university libraries, card catalogs, and spine-row stacks under cool daylight
options.thesis: The home page is a quiet reading room: courses sit like labeled spines, and the next step is as clear as a call number.
options.viewport: Full-bleed stacks atmosphere; brand يَطْمَئِن huge; one headline; one line; browse + register; no cards in the hero.
options.risk: Can read institutional if the wood and labels get fussy instead of generous.
options.case: Wins both axes: mixed Arabic visitors know libraries; catalog clarity proves ordered enrollment without SaaS chrome.

options.label: Painted Billboard
options.lineage: Hand-painted film hoardings — airbrushed faces, montage vignettes, outlined bilingual billing
options.thesis: Learning sold like a city hoarding: one monumental portrait of progress, courses as painted vignettes, yellow outlined CTA as billing.
options.viewport: Giant aspirational figure anchors; يَطْمَئِن as outlined title; vignette courses orbit; primary action in chrome-yellow billing.
options.risk: Spectacle can overpower reassurance and read as hype, not طمأنينة.
options.case: Strongest for “make something special”; loses product clarity — montage energy fights calm human-reviewed enrollment.

options.label: Duotone One-Sheet
options.lineage: Postwar crime film one-sheets — hard shadow, condensed caps, ruled billing block
options.thesis: Enrollment as a charged poster: one figure, a long cast shadow pointing the path, amber on the active billing line.
options.viewport: Hard duotone field; brand in condensed display; shadow points to browse CTA; billing block holds secondary actions.
options.risk: Noir tension and crime-poster grammar clash with reassurance.
options.case: Graphic punch is real; fuses poorly because crime-shadow drama fights the product’s calm contract.

options.label: Hand-Processed Film
options.lineage: 16mm hand-processed strips — scratches, light leaks, emulsion as event
options.thesis: Progress as frames on a strip: each course a sprocketed frame, orange leak marks the active lesson, edge codes as wayfinding.
options.viewport: Horizontal film strip as hero; يَطْمَئِن stamped in edge code; one frame lit; CTAs as splice marks.
options.risk: Atmospheric craft can hide what the product is and what to do next.
options.case: High craft atmosphere; loses product clarity — emulsion poetry does not explain enrollment review.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.lineage: Arabic edtech marketing page, executed at full craft
canonCard.thesis: Familiar hero, course cards, how-it-works steps, FAQ, and closing CTA — polished, not reinvented.
canonCard.viewport: Brand + headline + dual CTAs over gradient; course card grid below the fold.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other learning SaaS unless craft is exceptional.
